note: vespera_macro / vespera: the route cache key covers the cfg(test) verdicts of schemas and route files, so gating a module in src/lib.rs no longer serves a stale openapi.json; Set / Duration fields get Input request views without any serde attribute and unreached materialised .Input generic instances are pruned; fractional range bounds compile through nested Option layers, Option aliases and macro type groups; missing Schema derives inside tuples, arrays, slices and references are compile errors. Security schemes reject fields their type does not define and non-absolute OAuth2 / OpenID Connect URLs; server URLs with {var} templates and route folders with whitespace are rejected; repeated responses statuses are errors; a rejected #[route] keeps its handler; cron discovery scans modules of a call site outside src/ and stops at module cycles; nested inline modules inside cfg-gated ones are not rejected. schema_type!: ignore + name registers an explicitly named schema aliased by its Rust ident, schema! resolves renamed types like the OpenAPI document, partial naming a relation is an error, keyword key columns become raw fields. Fuzz, script, workflow and doc fixes.
